_about: Imports out of web-ui/src/lib/shared and web-ui/src/lib/net that break the dependency direction (shared/ and net/ import from no feature area; net/ imports no .svelte component). scripts/check-dependency-direction.mjs fails on any such edge not listed here and on any entry whose edge is gone, so this list only shrinks: never add an entry for new code; when you move a helper and an edge disappears, delete its entry in the same change.

ui.why: The /ws/events socket parses browser_open frames with the browser pane's parser; move parseAgentBrowserOpen and its type into net beside the other frame shapes.
The /ws/events handler table names the plugin platform frame type; move PlatformFrame into net with the other wire frame types.
The /ws/events handler table names the agent Link type it delivers; move that wire type into net.
The /ws/events handler table names the Notice frame type; move that wire type into net.
The /ws/events sessions snapshot is typed with the workspace Session type; move the Session wire type into net or shared.
The /ws/events socket parses update-status frames with the workspace update store's parser; move parseUpdateStatus and UpdateStatus into net.
The native bridge types remote_workspaces results with the workspace Workspace type; move that wire type into net or shared.
Upload path insertion carries the chat ImageAttachment type to the App-registered inserter; move that type into net or shared.
The branch chip formats git labels with the workspace session helpers; move baseName, branchLabel and SessionGit into shared.
Copying a file builds its /raw URL and detects images with the previews file helpers; move fsRawUrl and isImagePath into shared.
The code embed reads file text and sniffs binary content with the previews file client; move fsFile and looksBinary into shared.
The code embed lazily loads the editor's syntax highlighter so embeds colour code like the editor; move highlight.ts into shared.
The code embed lazily loads the editor's language list to pick a grammar by file name; move languages.ts into shared.
The embed resolver picks a body by the previews view kind and path basename; move viewKindFor and basename into shared.
The embed card shows size, mtime, download and table headers with the previews file helpers; move those helpers into shared.
The embed card retains a disk watch on its file so it refreshes on change; move the disk-watch registry into shared or net.
Table fragments are typed with the previews TablePage type; move that wire type into shared.
Table fragment labels reuse the table viewer's row-count formatter; move formatRowCount into shared.
The markdown embed reads its file with the previews file client; move fsFile into shared.
The markdown embed detects Marp sources to hand them to the slide body; move frontmatterOf and isMarpSource into shared.
The notebook embed strips ANSI from cell output with the previews helper; move stripAnsi into shared.
The notebook embed lazily loads the editor's syntax highlighter for code cells; move highlight.ts into shared.
The notebook embed parses .ipynb with the notebook viewer's parser so both render the same cells; move notebook.ts into shared.
The notebook embed renders HTML outputs with the notebook viewer's sandboxed frame; move NotebookHtml.svelte into shared.
The slide embed resolves image paths with the previews dirname helper; move dirname into shared.
The slide embed renders a deck with the slides viewer's Marp pipeline so both look the same; move marp.ts into shared.
The table embed pages CSV and spreadsheet data with the previews table clients; move fsTable, fsXlsx and their types into shared.
Extension code blocks lazily load the editor's syntax highlighter; move highlight.ts into shared.
Extension code blocks lazily load the editor's language list to pick a grammar; move languages.ts into shared.
The file icon picks its glyph with the previews iconFor mapping; move iconFor into shared beside icons.ts.
Key hints and chord matching read user overrides from the live settings store; inject a settings reader instead of importing the store.
Reference links plug into the document hover controller and name its HostTarget type; move that type into shared.
The wake ring draws its countdown with the chat loops helpers; move ringFraction and untilLabel into shared.
